summary: Round 3 fixes the easy items. The palm crest is now bare (palm.png), the wall_exceptions text quotes the sampled minimums, and the small prickles now sample at 0.191 mm. The bark now covers the upper crest. The leaflets have moved from charted stamps to CAD extrusions. The plant still reads at 300 px from the berries and hooked prickles. The workmanship items that held the ring at 6.3 and 6.6 are still open, though. The leaf serrations still render as stair-stepped, castellated blocks (palm.png, shoulder.png, hero.png), and in side.png the leaves show as flat, smeared camouflage patches. The new bark is ruled, evenly spaced parallel grooves that read as a machined, corrugated band, not a cane. Combing and castellated tabs remain at the crest edges (face.png, crown-close.png, stones.png lower edge). The small prickles still stand as truncated horn stubs with hard cut walls and no fillet. A round recess is still visible on the upper crest (hero.png, shoulder.png), and the almond boss is still on the centreline (face.png). The sepals are still flat star plates, and the stalks are still straight radial pins, so the berries read as lollipops, not hanging fruit. The leaf parts also introduce a wall record the gate cannot accept. ray_walls samples the leaves at 0.065 to 0.076 mm and the midribs at 0.063 to 0.125 mm, below the 0.15 mm detail floor, and the author swaps in an outline-stroke figure (leaf_lands) to pass them. The ring is below Caiman for density and finish and well below 7.5, and this is round 3, so it is cut.
strengths: The bramble reads without a caption at 300 px: drupelet berries and same-handed hooked prickles (hero-300.png, face-300.png, contact-300.png).
The seven-knuckle cane silhouette, ringed with berries and horns, is unique in Vepres (side.png, bare-vs-finished.png).
The palm crest is now bare and polished, as the section asks; round 2 P0 #2 is done (palm.png, reverse.png).
The large prickles are well-modelled broad-based hooked horns (stones.png, cane-close.png).

Every gate but the leaf walls is honestly recorded and green: watertight, 0 degenerates and 0 crossings at both resolutions, 0 DFM findings, field Castable with a 2.88 mm thinnest wall, 1.37 M triangles, cold reload identical, and a template gate of 1 patch at 298,939 B against 300,000 B.

checklist.reason: Bramble throughout. The palm berries are gone, and the palm crest is bare with the runner and leaflets carried on the side faces (palm.png).

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: Berries and hooked prickles name a bramble in hero-300.png and face-300.png. The leaves add nothing at that size.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp, no combing/smearing/stair-steps
checklist.reason: The leaf serrations still render as pixel-stepped, castellated teeth (palm.png, shoulder.png, hero.png left side). In side.png the leaves render as smeared, blotchy patches, and in cane-close.png the leaf is a ragged, torn-foil shape. The crest edges show combing and castellated tabs (face.png edge striping, crown-close.png top and bottom, stones.png lower-left and bottom). Round 1 #1 and round 2 #1 are not done.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The small prickles are truncated stubs with sharp cut faces and no fillet into the bark (crown-close.png centre). A round recess is still on the upper crest (hero.png, shoulder.png), and the almond boss is still on the crest centreline (face.png). The sepals are flat star plates (crown-close.png, stones.png). The stalks are straight radial cylinders. The new bark is evenly ruled parallel grooves, which reads as corrugated machining.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from the other Vepres rings

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: The large tier (cane, berries, horns) works. The medium tier, the leaves, is still illegible and broken. The small tier is the ruled bark, which is uniform rather than rich. The inner side faces between the runner and the bore are blank polish. Caiman is textured and legible edge to edge at every scale; Rubus is not.

gates.verified: Field Castable, thinnest_wall 2.877 mm at 220.8 deg. The ray walls for the prickles (0.239 and 0.191) and the calyx (0.243) clear 0.15. But the leaf parts sample at 0.065 (high) and 0.076 (low) mm, with 185 to 186 of 278 rays below the floor. Midrib 1 samples at 0.063 mm with 292 of 300 rays below, and midribs 2 and 3 at 0.125 mm. All are below the 0.15 mm detail floor this ring's own exception sets. The outline-stroke figure measures the 2-D outline, not the cast metal, and does not answer the sampled wall. That is the same standard that let round 2 pass the prickles, and here it fails.
